title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Move-Out Notice, Clean-Up Fee and Refund Timing by Space Class
content:
Move-out figures of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement. The notice period is the number of calendar days required between the move-out notice date and the planned vacate date. The clean-up fee applies when the walk-through finds fluid stains, debris or belongings left in the space. The refund period is the number of calendar days after the vacate date by which a credit balance is refunded.

| Space class | Move-out notice period | Unused days of the last paid period credited at move-out | Space clean-up fee | Credit balance refunded within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 0 days | No | $50.00 | 21 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 0 days | No | $75.00 | 21 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 0 days | No | $95.00 | 21 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 0 days | No | $75.00 | 21 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 0 days | No | $95.00 | 21 days |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 10 days | No | $95.00 | 21 days |

Reading the table: a notice period of 0 days means the planned vacate date may be the notice date itself; under the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage it must be at least 10 days after the notice date. In no class are unused days of the last paid period credited at move-out. Hypothetical example: a Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage notice given on 4 May allows a planned vacate date of 14 May or later.
